slides.h1: How to make a flyer people actually scan.
slides.lead: I'm marketing my app with QR flyers. Here's what matters on that piece of paper.
My users live in the same building. The lobby and the lift beat any feed.
"Don't know your neighbors?" stops people. An app name nobody knows yet doesn't.
If it takes a paragraph to explain, it won't get read in a lift.
Big code, high contrast, straight to the App Store page. No landing page in between.
Use a different link per building, so you know which places actually work.

slides.h2: You don't have to hand them out yourself.
slides.lead: A distribution vendor can cover many buildings while you keep building.

slides.h2: Would you scan a flyer in your lobby?
